cell.v: the value; null when no page read gives it, false or [] when a page states it is not there
cell.src: the id of the source the value was read from
cell.quote: the page's own words that carry the value
cell.how: stated, or derived with the formula
cell.official: whether the vendor published the value
cell.scope: what the value is said of when not the product alone: compute-capability, architecture, series, family, driver, inferred, absence, variant
cell.why: why an empty cell is empty
cell.also: further sources the quote is taken from
cell.seen: search: the value was seen in a search result only
cell.confirmed_by: a third-party source that states the same value
cell.differs: the value, source and quote of a third-party source that states another value
cell.was: the value and source of the unofficial cell this one replaced
